name: article-digest-llm-helper
description: LLM batch summarizer for the article-digest pipeline. Called from digest.py.
comment: z-ai-web-dev-sdk is optionalDependencies because it is only required when LLM_PROVIDER=zai (the default). Users on the 'openai' backend do not need it. Node 18+ provides global fetch, required by the openai backend.
